note: Phase-1 recorded-fixture baseline (D13-a). The CI eval-gate fails a PR whose overall intent accuracy drops >2pp below this. Re-record fixtures and bump this number when the prompt/model legitimately improves; nightly live runs (Anthropic/OpenAI) catch silent model drift.
stale_note: These fixtures were recorded under prompt v2. Prompt v3 (intent catalogue rendered from intents.yaml, tie-break rules, language rules, sender block, confidence rubric) has not been measured: the gate replays recorded outputs, so it still reports 0.88 whatever the prompt says. 0.88 is the v2 number until someone re-records against v3 with a live key, and the six misses it counts are all confusable pairs that v3 writes explicit tie-breaks for. Treat a v3 re-record as the real measurement of this change.
